units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: 6. A municipal servant is granted guarantees in accordance with federal legislation.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: 7. A municipal servant is granted the following additional guarantees:
units.label: Point 7 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: allocation of subsidies for the purchase and construction of housing from the funds of the relevant local budget;
units.label: Point 7 Art. 42 · “allocation of subsidies for the purchase and construction of…”

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: monetary reimbursement of transport expenses or provision of official transport, taking into account the content and extent of the official duties performed;
units.label: Point 7 Art. 42 · “monetary reimbursement of transport expenses or provision of…”

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: monetary reimbursement of representation expenses according to the procedure and in the amounts determined by the City Duma;
units.label: Point 7 Art. 42 · “monetary reimbursement of representation expenses according to…”

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: a supplement to the state pension according to the procedure and in the amounts determined by the City Duma.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 42 · “a supplement to the state pension according to the procedure…”

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: Article 42-1. Guarantees for the exercise of the powers of deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Point 7 Art. 42 · “Article 42-1. Guarantees for the exercise of the powers of…”

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: The following guarantees for the exercise of the powers of deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg are established at the expense of the municipal budget:
units.label: Point 7 Art. 42 · “The following guarantees for the exercise of the powers of…”

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: 1) access to information necessary to exercise the powers of deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg, according to the procedure established by municipal legal acts in accordance with federal and oblast legislation;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 7 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: 2) use, for exercising the powers of deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg, of official premises, communications facilities and office equipment intended to support the activities of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 7 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: 3) transport services necessary to exercise the powers of deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg, according to the procedure established by municipal legal acts;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 7 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: 4) professional education and additional professional education for a deputy of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 7 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: 5) provision of supplementary pension benefits, taking into account the period of exercise of their powers and according to the procedure and conditions established by municipal legal acts, to a citizen who has ceased exercising the powers of a deputy of the City Duma or the Head of Yekaterinburg, who exercised those powers on a full-time basis and reached pensionable age or lost capacity for work while exercising powers in one of those offices (except where those powers were terminated on one or more grounds involving failure to observe restrictions or prohibitions or to perform duties, upon termination on which federal law bars the provision to citizens who held those offices of additional social or other guarantees in connection with the termination of their powers);
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 7 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: 6) timely payment in full of salaries to deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg who exercise their powers on a full-time basis, in the amounts and according to the procedure established by municipal legal acts;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 7 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: 7) granting to deputies of the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg who exercise their powers on a full-time basis annual basic paid leave and annual additional paid leave, the duration of which is determined by municipal legal acts;
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 7 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: 8) reimbursement to deputies of the City Duma of telephone service expenses and other documented expenses connected with the exercise of their powers, in the amounts and according to the procedure established by municipal legal acts, and compensation for expenses connected with carrying out deputies’ activities.
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 7 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Municipal service
units.text: A deputy of the City Duma is guaranteed retention of their job (post) for a period totalling six working days per month to exercise their powers on a non-full-time basis.
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 7 Art. 42 · “A deputy of the City Duma is guaranteed retention of their job…”

units.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma
units.text: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma
units.label: Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma
units.text: 1. The powers of the City Duma terminate early in the event of:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma
units.text: 1) adoption by the City Duma of a decision on self-dissolution. The corresponding decision on self-dissolution is adopted by at least two thirds of the established number of deputies of the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma
units.text: 2) entry into force of a court decision that the current composition of deputies of the City Duma lacks authority, including as a result of deputies of the City Duma resigning their powers;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma
units.text: 3) transformation or abolition of the municipality;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma
units.text: 4) dissolution of the City Duma according to the procedure and on the grounds provided for by federal legislation;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma
units.text: 5) failure to meet the deadline for issuing a municipal legal act necessary to implement a decision adopted through the population’s direct expression of will in accordance with federal legislation;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma
units.text: 6) an increase of more than 25 percent in the number of voters in the municipality as a result of changes to the municipality’s boundaries or the merger of a settlement with an urban okrug.
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma
units.text: 2. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma entails early termination of the powers of its deputies.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Early termination of the powers of the City Duma
units.text: 3. In the event of early termination of the powers of the City Duma, early municipal elections are held according to the procedure and within the time limits established by electoral legislation.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1. The powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg terminate early in the following cases:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1) resignation at their own request;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2) removal from office in accordance with federal law;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3) being declared legally incapable or of limited legal capacity by a court;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4) being declared missing or dead by a court;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 5) entry into legal force of a court judgment convicting them;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 6) departure from the Russian Federation for permanent residence abroad;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 7) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship of a foreign state that is a party to an international treaty of the Russian Federation under which a foreign citizen has the right to be elected to local self-government bodies; possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or of a residence permit or other document confirming the right of a citizen of the Russian Federation, or of a foreign citizen entitled under an international treaty of the Russian Federation to be elected to local self-government bodies, to permanent residence in a foreign state, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 8) recall by voters;
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 9) a court-established persistent inability, for health reasons, to exercise the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg;
units.label: Subpoint 9 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 10) death;
units.label: Subpoint 10 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 11) transformation or abolition of the municipality;
units.label: Subpoint 11 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 12) an increase of more than 25 percent in the number of voters in the municipality as a result of changes to the municipality’s boundaries or the merger of a settlement with an urban okrug;
units.label: Subpoint 12 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 12-1) acquisition of foreign-agent status;
units.label: Subpoint 12-1 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 13) dismissal from office according to the procedure and on the grounds provided for by federal law.
units.label: Subpoint 13 Point 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2. A decision on early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg on the ground provided for in subpoint 1 of point 1 of this Article of the Charter is adopted by the City Duma on the basis of the Head’s written application.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: A decision on early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg on the ground provided for in subpoint 13 of point 1 of this Article of the Charter is adopted by the City Duma on the initiative of deputies of the City Duma or the Governor of Sverdlovsk Oblast, according to the procedure and on the grounds provided for by federal law.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 46 · “A decision on early termination of the powers of the Head of…”

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3. The powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg also terminate early due to loss of the confidence of the President of the Russian Federation if the Head of Yekaterinburg, their spouse and minor children fail to comply with the prohibition established by Federal Law of 7 May 2013 No. 79-ФЗ ‘On Prohibiting Certain Categories of Persons from Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments’.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 09.12.2025 No. 39/43.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 5. In the event of early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg, the Head of Yekaterinburg is elected no later than six months after the date of such termination.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: If less than six months remain before the expiry of the City Duma’s term of office, the Head of Yekaterinburg is elected from among candidates presented by the Governor of Sverdlovsk Oblast within three months of the date on which a legally competent composition of the City Duma is elected.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 46 · “If less than six months remain before the expiry of the City…”

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 6. If the Head of Yekaterinburg, whose powers were terminated early on the basis of a legal act of the Governor of Sverdlovsk Oblast removing them from office or a decision of the City Duma dismissing the Head of Yekaterinburg from office, challenges that legal act or decision in court, the City Duma may not adopt a decision on electing the Head of Yekaterinburg until the court decision enters into legal force.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Early termination of the powers of the Head of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 46-1. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 25.05.2018 No. 11/81.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 46 · “Article 46-1. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City…”

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.label: Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 1. The powers of a deputy of the City Duma terminate early in the following cases:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 1) resignation at their own request;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 2) being declared legally incapable or of limited legal capacity by a court;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 3) being declared missing or dead by a court;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 4) entry into legal force of a court judgment convicting them;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 5) departure from the Russian Federation for permanent residence abroad;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 1 Art. 47
